messages.subject: Re: billing
messages.body:
We keep saying soon because I don't want to build the wrong version of it and then be stuck supporting it forever. Rosalind's surgery packages are not how most clinics work, and if we build for her edge case first we're designing around one person.

Read-only sounds smaller than it is. Their old systems export to eight different formats and none of them agree on what a line item is. This is still four weeks if nothing breaks.

messages.subject: Re: billing
messages.body:
rosalind is the only one actually using it

maybe she's the case and we don't have the rest yet because we're not building what they need

messages.subject: Re: billing
messages.body:
I'm not building for Rosalind, I'm building something fifty clinics can use, and you're selling a product that doesn't exist yet and then telling me the thing I'm actually building isn't what you already promised.

We have thirteen weeks of runway. Billing the way you're describing it is six weeks if it goes well, and the scheduler still has the room-booking thing half-fixed and Nkechi hasn't said yes and I don't know what happens if she doesn't. I can't take six weeks on something that might be wrong when we don't have six weeks to waste.

You want me to build faster and I want you to stop selling things I haven't scoped yet. I don't know how to do both.
